system.description:
When the gods fell silent, someone had to hold the line. You are that someone: a soldier, a sellsword, a veteran of a hundred stinking battlefields where the lamps ran out before the war did. You trust your steel, your armour and the shield-brother at your side, because nothing else in this world has ever held. You need neither magic nor mercy, only the next breath and the next blow.

Class feature: Armour mastery
Years of war have taught you to move in iron. You ignore the Agility and defence penalties of armour of tier 3 or lower. Tier 4 armour keeps its full penalties.

Class power: Power strike 🟒1 ◈◈
